head: Powday snow forecast app gives ski areas a 15-day snowfall outlook
dek: Powday is a free snow forecast app for skiers and snowboarders that gives every ski area worldwide a snowfall forecast for up to 15 days, blended from six or more weather models. It was #62 among free Weather apps on the US App Store on 18 November.
details: Days 1 to 7 are free, with unlimited resorts, radar, resort snow reports, storm alerts when a forecast passes your snow threshold, and webcams for your first three resorts. Powday Pro, a monthly or yearly subscription, adds days 8 to 15, hour-by-hour snow, all webcams and webcam timelapses. An AI forecaster writes a daily snow discussion for your resorts. The app came out on 9 November and is made by Shredder Inc.
where: App Store, iPhone, free with Pro subscription
means: If you plan ski days around fresh snow, you get one snowfall number per day for your resorts, with the first week free.
todo: Search Powday on the App Store, add your resorts and set a snow alert; it needs iOS 18 or later.
